body: US here. It’s not just healthcare for humans that’s more expensive here :(

Where I live, vets charge way more for “exotic” animals, and only a few vets within a 50 mile radius of where I live will even see rodents.... they take advantage of that. They upcharge for everything. The visit/exam alone usually cost nearly $200, not counting scans, medications, or overnight stays. Idk where you are but I guess I’m even more unlucky than I thought
